# @ndigo/platform-web

Browser platform adapter for Ndigo — dispatcher glue, history/cookie resolvers, themes

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Subpaths

- `@ndigo/platform-web/browser-dispatcher`
- `@ndigo/platform-web/web-auto-configuration`
- `@ndigo/platform-web/browser-theme`

## Public exports

- `filterImportMetaEnv` — Filters an `import.meta.env`-style object down to the client-visible keys (matching the given prefix — the Vite `VITE_` contract by default).
- `BrowserEnvironment` — Browser-specific environment implementation for `@ndigo/platform-web` applications.

- `configureBrowserArgumentResolvers` — Registers browser-specific argument resolvers into the application context.

- `BrowserCookieValueMethodArgumentResolver` — Browser cookie argument resolver using `document.cookie` parsing.
- `CookieLanguageResolver` — Resolves the active language from a persisted cookie, falling back to the browser language and then the configured default.
- `configureCookieLanguageResolver` — Registers a cookie-backed language resolver into the given context.
- `CookieThemeResolver` — Resolves the active theme from a persisted cookie, falling back to the system color-scheme preference and then the configured default.
- `configureCookieThemeResolver` — Registers a cookie-backed theme resolver into the given context.

- `CookieJar` *(type)* — Minimal cookie-jar API exposed by the platform-web package.
- `CookieAttributes` *(type)* — Additional attributes to append to a cookie (e.g. path, expires, secure).
- `CookieParseResult` *(type)* — Parsed result returned by the cookie parser.
- `Cookies` — Default cookie jar bound to the current browser environment.
- `LOCALE_COOKIE_NAME` — The cookie name persisting the user's locale choice.
- `currentLocale` — Reactive locale state for the browser — views subscribed to this signal re-render and re-format when the locale changes.
- `changeLocale` — Sets the active locale on the client.
- `BrowserHistoryStateValueMethodArgumentResolver` — Browser history-state argument resolver.
- `dumpStorage` — Dumps every key/value pair of a browser storage object into a plain record.
- `BrowserStorageValueMethodArgumentResolver` — Browser storage argument resolver for `sessionStorage` and `localStorage`.

- `BrowserDispatcher` — Browser application dispatcher.
- `WebAutoConfiguration`
